patterns.note: Layered depth layouts where high-fidelity 3D renders of industrial hardware physically overlap large display typography, creating a strong sense of three-dimensional space.

Scroll-driven interactive storytelling where a central 3D model rotates, zooms, and transitions into exploded views to highlight different technical capabilities (Heat, Hydrogen, Electricity) as the user scrolls.
Ultra-clean, light-weight sans-serif typography used at massive scale for hero headings, contrasted with small, wide-tracked uppercase labels for technical metadata.
A sophisticated transition from airy, sky-blue gradients in the hero to deep charcoal and black backgrounds for technical and interactive product sections.

technique_notes: To recreate the hero depth effect, layer a transparent 3D model render (or WebGL canvas) over a large absolute-positioned heading, allowing the model's foreground elements to physically mask and sit in front of the text.
Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate a scroll-bound 3D model animation, where scrolling down triggers rotation, zoom, and exploded-view states of the reactor core alongside fading text callouts.
For the team headshots, apply a soft vertical gradient mask at the bottom of each portrait to seamlessly fade the figures into the light background canvas.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized light display headings (~6x body size) paired with highly readable, medium-weight body copy and small uppercase metadata.

standout: The seamless integration of a highly detailed 3D reactor core that acts as both a visual centerpiece and an interactive storytelling device, disassembling and rotating directly in response to the user's scroll.
